## Remote Team Meeting Plan — 2026-02-18, 14:00–15:15 UTC
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

A concise 75-minute agenda for 7 participants across New York, London, and Singapore, with a built-in 5-minute buffer at the end for action items. The flow is designed to keep discussion tight and decision-focused.

## Agenda Blocks and Note-Taking Structure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg

14:00–14:05 — Welcome and goals
- Confirm meeting goal, desired outcomes, and decision owners
- Quick attendee roll call across time zones

14:05–14:20 — Pre-read recap
- Highlight the 2–3 most important points from the pre-read
- Capture questions that need clarification, not debate

14:20–14:50 — Discussion and decisions
- Review key topics in priority order
- Record decisions, open questions, and blockers in real time

14:50–15:05 — Action planning
- Assign owners, deadlines, and dependencies
- Confirm what will be shared after the meeting

15:05–15:10 — Buffer for action items
- Final edits to action list
- Confirm next check-in or follow-up owner

15:10–15:15 — Close
- Restate decisions and next steps
- End on time

Note-taking structure:
- Meeting goal
- Attendees
- Pre-read highlights
- Decisions made
- Open questions
- Action items: owner, due date, status
- Risks/blockers
- Follow-up needed

## Reminder Message Draft
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/phone.svg

Subject: Reminder — Remote Team Meeting on 2026-02-18

Hi team,

This is a reminder for our remote team meeting on **2026-02-18 from 14:00 to 15:15 UTC**.

**Meeting goal:** align on the key priorities, make the needed decisions, and leave with clear owners and next steps.

**Required pre-read:** please review the shared pre-read before the meeting so we can focus on discussion and decisions rather than background.

We will keep the last **5 minutes** reserved for action items, owner assignments, and final confirmations.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
